risks.consequence: Legacy gate only accepts PM4/PN4, no postprocessing overlap, fixed D0–D2 source inventory and exact compile argv. Reusing it as the offline-run completion condition can stop after rerunning D2, without any optimized candidate or submission work.
risks.required_gate: Use a separate offline status/gate/readiness path and explicit optimization/submission/repetition fields. READY_FOR_REVIEW is provisional. Require actual CLI exit0, current candidate comparison, source/output identities and independent review; never copy D2 booleans to satisfy it.

risks.consequence: Modifying D2 sources in place invalidates their bound accepted artifacts and makes later claimed speedup/rollback ambiguous. Historical report copies can silently point to changed source files.
risks.required_gate: Freeze all D2 source/config/gate/input identities and acceptance record. Prefer new candidate module/source paths. Verify D2 hashes before and after the run. Preserve D2 as executable baseline and never relabel its accepted records as new-candidate PASS.

risks.consequence: Single-W/double-buffer scheduling changes legal backpressure, COMMIT/START ordering and slot ownership. A future OPEN may block a required START, or a blocking CPU write can prevent that same CPU draining Y. Current whole-row ACK driver is not the tile stream interface.
risks.required_gate: Drive public input and output concurrently. Test future OPEN before START, starvation at full W/Y slot, held last output, simultaneous ingress/retire/done, queued invalid event and held next BEGIN; assert progress only under stated fairness. For E203 use nonblocking status/capacity with feed/drain interleaving; system_done waits for final shared-memory write response.

risks.consequence: Analytic CTX4 cycles or lower RAM reads do not prove real DUT speedup, and core-only speedup is not contest end-to-end throughput. Different ready patterns, warm weights, configuration or frequency corrupt a comparison.
risks.required_gate: Run D2 and each candidate on identical hashed arrays, shifts, seeds, RAM latency and ready schedule with cold load. Count actual handshake/retirement cycles separately for load/compute/output/total; include all 25344 accepted outputs. End-to-end score claim additionally requires real CPU/bus load-to-writeback window. Record simulator wall seconds separately.

risks.consequence: Fast compute, low inferred storage and best energy may belong to different configurations; choosing each separately creates a fictional winning design. A cached binary can also execute old source.
risks.required_gate: Use candidate_id and immutable run_id; bind top/source manifest/config/firmware/input/expected/tool hashes, simulator binary and actual compile/sim argv. Selection points to one complete artifact set. Cache key includes every HDL include/source/define/parameter and tool identity. Dirty source requires new run.

risks.consequence: CTX4 tags, partial sums and early postprocessing can drop/duplicate k63, mix row/tile/task, add bias repeatedly or quantize a partial sum. Small random vectors may miss tie/overflow behavior.
risks.required_gate: Keep old signed16→exact48 dot→signed49 bias→sat48→symmetric RNE0..47→sat32 order and both flag meanings. Check partial sums before quantization and all final records; all shifts, signed extrema, ties, saturation, zero, odd tail rows and k63-only impulses remain mandatory.

risks.consequence: Old E203 FFN1 runner compiles rtl/ffn1_top.sv/dot64.sv, writes fixed reports/system/e203-ffn1 and work/e203_ffn1_handoff.json. Running it directly overwrites frozen evidence and still does not execute RevD.
risks.required_gate: Create a candidate-specific adapter/driver/TB/runner with output-root argument and independent manifest. Compile actual candidate top and verify CPU-visible results in poisoned shared SRAM. Preserve old runner/record. Until then mark RevD E203 NOT_RUN even when old E203 baseline PASS exists.

risks.consequence: Current RevD entry defaults to a C-drive external DV venv, while old E203 entry requires repo .venv-dv. ZIP can omit ignored weights/binaries/headers/symlinks or include only evidence without reproducible inputs. Legacy verifier checks its manifest members and cannot establish new candidate inclusion.
risks.required_gate: Package one selected candidate with runtime requirements/lock, source includes/vendor license, numeric model, input generator or distributable fixtures, driver, TB, config and one entrypoint. New package manifest enumerates every new member and relative reference. Extract in a fresh directory, reconstruct the four pinned E203 symlinks on Linux, then compile/run short candidate independently without absolute workspace/venv dependencies. Do not bundle secrets or local virtualenv.

risks.consequence: Historical full12-layer E203 pingpong/reload each cost about2.8–2.9h. Launching both consumes the entire new window and prevents optimized FFN1 validation/reproduction. Unbounded parallel Verilator builds also compete for RAM and filesystem.
risks.required_gate: Prioritize FFN1 candidate short tests and full sizes. Bound compile jobs/process count. Reserve final45–60min for regressions, independent repeat and fresh-extraction package check. Historical FFN1 full+repeat approximately443+416s are a resource estimate only; fresh candidate time must be measured. No giant whole-encoder rerun unless core goals finish and remaining budget supports it.

risks.consequence: 36 engineering examples and generic synthesis do not satisfy official600 precision, official12 cold performance tasks, target150MHz, <=2.25mm² area or physical power/energy. Efficiency/innovation scoring itself has eligibility gates.

Prefer completing mandatory undergraduate task3 reproducibility/integration before optional whole-encoder scope. Keep physical area/energy unknown distinct from macro-count proxy.

risks.consequence: A green scoreboard might not observe the candidate datapath, and a mutation failing compilation cannot prove detection of a functional bug.
risks.required_gate: At least compiled numeric(tag/sign/k63), concurrency(owner/credit/overwrite) and completion mutations must fail during simulation for expected assertions/mismatches. Separately remove one required boundary/case/hash/command from a copied evidence bundle and require aggregate-gate rejection. Never modify golden or weaken assertions.

risks.consequence: Quick READY from baseline replay can end before the authorized sustained optimization. Conversely a deadline can leave an in-flight failing candidate incorrectly selected.
risks.required_gate: Completion requires meaningful measured candidate experiment(s), submission integrity and bounded review, not elapsed time alone. Stop launching long jobs before deadline, finish validation of last known good candidate, record declined/incomplete alternatives and preserve logs. The best verified design may remain D2 if all candidates fail or regress.
